rust_summary: the light, biome and block collision of any open level (`native_level_light`, `native_level_biome`, `native_level_block_collision`).
doc_summary: `native_level_light(level, pos)`, `native_level_biome(level, pos)` and `native_level_block_collision(level, pos)` read the light, the biome and the collision boxes of a block in the level a `LevelRef` names, where `native_light`, `native_biome` and `native_block_collision` read the level in place (API @API:level_reads@).
